exclusion_detail: The compounds are phosphinic pseudopeptides made on Wang resin by solid-phase peptide synthesis (Fmoc strategy, resin cleavage, RP-HPLC) from a phosphinic dipeptide building block that itself takes seven steps in solution; compound 11 is a pseudopeptide-PEG-cyanine dye conjugate. Independently, each route is over 4 reactions.

lead.label: 8 (and its probe derivative 11)
lead.why: The abstract names no single compound; rule 2: the text says 'compound 8 displaying a high potency and selectivity toward hCPA 1, 2, and 3 was selected as a relevant starting scaffold for the development of an optical probe 11', the main follow-up experiment (crystal structures of three candidates were also obtained).

notes: Only the solution-phase building block 17 (Fmoc-Ala-POOAd-hPhe-OH, Scheme 1: diethylmalonate -> acrylate 12 (3 steps) -> benzyl ester 13 -> P-Michael with phosphinic acid 15 (made from 14, 'previously reported') -> adamantyl protection, hydrogenolysis) is a small-molecule synthesis, and it is 7+ steps and relies on a previously reported precursor. Not examined further.
